key_idea: Count the pairs where the first die wins and the pairs where the second wins and compare.
sketch: With n<=1000 simply enumerate all n^2 face pairs, counting first>second and second>first; ties are ignored. Compare the two counts and print first/second/tie. O(n^2)=1e6. Sorting plus two pointers would give O(n log n) but is unnecessary. Use 64-bit counters only out of habit (max 1e6).
